title: PumpFun Launch-to-Graduation Corpus (Jun-Jul 2026)
research_method: downloaded all selected files, verified pinned SHA-256 values, queried full tables and replayed chronological cohorts
population: 798,430 Pump.fun launches including graduates and non-graduates
claim: the release preserves bonding-curve launch paths, outcomes and documented quality defects
test_method: full DuckDB audit, contamination exclusions, fixed-frequency chronological research and warehouse materialization
result: verified and ingested; only 40 days deep coverage, 1,486 suspect concentration rows excluded, no feature approved
limitations: short window, July outage, some fields lack per-field availability timestamps and wallet totals are stale
license_state: MIT dataset card; upstream data rights not expanded

title: Trenches pump.fun Forward Capture, 2026-08
research_method: downloaded release, verified every selected checksum and audited field-block derivability timestamps
population: 85,442 mints and 730,850 forward observations across four venues
claim: field-block timestamps make launch-time leakage measurable
test_method: materialized launch, funding and buyer evidence and retained the published capture outage
result: verified and ingested; useful prospective-style timing evidence but too short for validation
limitations: seven-day window, 69.09-hour outage and vendor-curated enrichment
license_state: public dataset release; preserve published license terms

title: MELT: A Behavioral Trace Dataset for High-Risk Memecoin Launch Detection
research_method: downloaded core tables, verified SHA-256 values and audited labels, bundle graph and identity fields
population: 41,470 launches with behavioral labels and coordinated-account traces
claim: co-purchase, fund-flow and Jito traces expose coordinated launch behavior
test_method: queried bundle relationships and checked cardinality and availability of identity fields
result: bundle evidence retained for research; constant creator column rejected and migration-time features barred from launch decisions
limitations: CC BY-NC, creator identity defect, and many engineered fields are not launch-time available

title: Bridging Culture and Finance: A Multimodal Analysis of Memecoins in the Web3 Ecosystem
research_method: examined abstract, dataset description and linked repository data
data_window: 2024 through 2024-11-01 in the acquired financial table
population: multimodal Pump.fun token collection; local table contains 3,751 migrated tokens
claim: visual, textual, community and financial attributes can be studied jointly
test_method: cloned repository, checksum-pinned the financial table and audited population construction
result: useful narrative context; severe migrated-only survivorship bias makes it ineligible for runner or failure rates
limitations: retrospective survivor-only financial subset and no fixed-horizon path truth

title: Coin-Meme public repository
research_method: cloned actual repository, inspected schema and counted dates, tokens, missing descriptions and migration times
claim: the table provides 2024 descriptions, capitalization and migration timing
test_method: DuckDB full-file audit and SHA-256 verification
result: 3,751 rows, 527 missing descriptions, zero missing migration timestamps, median migration time 290 seconds
limitations: migrated tokens only; cannot represent dead launches, rugs or the launch denominator
license_state: MIT repository; upstream source rights not expanded

title: Pump.fun Token Sentiment and Risk Analysis
research_method: downloaded all four files, verified pinned checksums and audited all rows, dates, agents and quality flags
population: 193,410 timestamped analyses over 86,838 mints from 25 agents
claim: the release supplies time-stamped narrative summaries and controlled risk-factor vocabulary
test_method: full DuckDB profile with quality, class and coverage counts
result: 129,459 rows meet quality_score >=0.7; retained only as context because no outcomes or independent human-social truth exist
limitations: AI-generated sentiment, unknown selection policy, 13-day window, non-commercial license and no outcome labels

title: Solana memecoin calls - a public record with the misses left in
research_method: cloned current repository and executed the bundled SHA-256 attestation verifier
claim: the call file is hash-anchored and cannot be back-dated
test_method: compared the cloned calls.jsonl SHA-256 to attest.json using the bundled verifier
result: rejected: actual hash 9f0278... differs from attested cd3bc9...; no rows used
limitations: current data file is newer than or different from the attested bytes and peak is a ratcheting ceiling

title: solarchive.org Solana Blockchain Datasets
research_method: examined dataset card, schemas, coverage and partition index
population: non-vote Solana transactions plus accounts and token metadata
claim: daily Parquet partitions provide complete public chain history with checksums
test_method: reviewed index and storage footprint against the 24-month Pump.fun requirement
result: technically suitable raw source but full acquisition and protocol decoding exceed current 8.72 TB local capacity
limitations: very large raw archive; Pump.fun instruction decoding and completeness validation still required

title: SOLMEMES: Do SPL Token Descriptions and Symbols Have Predictive Power?
research_method: examined dataset card, population construction and linked paper metadata
population: 8,960 graduated Solana memecoins with first 15 post-migration minutes
claim: token descriptions and symbols can be tested alongside early trading paths
test_method: checked population against unbiased launch-universe and decision-horizon requirements
result: candidate narrative context only; excluded from failure rates because all tokens graduated
limitations: graduated-only survivor bias and post-migration observation start
license_state: public dataset card; verify artifact license before acquisition

title: PumpSwap historical trades
research_method: examined dataset card, schema and source lineage
population: PumpSwap trade transactions for pump-suffixed mints
claim: raw Solana blocks can reconstruct post-migration trade paths
test_method: mapped available columns to migration-continuation and liquidity-collapse requirements
result: relevant post-migration candidate; not yet acquired or joined to an unbiased launch denominator
limitations: post-migration only and no demonstrated point-in-time launch linkage in this run

title: Catching the Rug: Early Prediction of Fraudulent Memecoins on Solana via Machine Learning
research_method: examined abstract, population, horizon and cross-platform claims
population: 6.4 million Solana tokens across Pump.fun and Raydium as claimed
claim: first-five-minute trading features can predict one-hour rug characteristics and cross-source fusion reduces domain shift
test_method: mapped claim to independent failure probability and strict cross-regime replay requirements
result: high-value hypothesis; not replicated because the underlying 6.4M-token dataset was not released in the examined material
limitations: preprint claim, rug-label definition and dataset availability require full audit

title: SolRugDetector: Investigating Rug Pulls on Solana
research_method: examined abstract, labeling population and behavioral framing
population: 117 confirmed rug tokens derived from 68 incident reports
claim: Solana rug behavior is driven by on-chain market manipulation rather than token-code backdoors
test_method: mapped operational behavior to creator, funder, concentration and liquidity-collapse evidence
result: supports behavior-first risk decomposition but sample is too small and selected for production calibration
limitations: case-selected positive set and no broad launch denominator in the abstract
license_state: public preprint; data license requires verification

title: Pump.fun Graduation Regime Windows: Survival Analysis of 832,941 Token Launches
research_method: examined paper and acquired the RED-PUMP-2026 release for local audit
population: 860,213-launch released dataset; 832,941 launches in survival analysis claim
claim: graduation behavior changes across regime windows and social presence has a measurable association
test_method: retained as regime and graduation evidence separate from runner outcomes
result: useful large failure denominator but still a short single-year regime, not multi-year validation
limitations: graduation is not equivalent to a copyable 2x/5x runner outcome

title: The Memecoin Phenomenon: An In-Depth Study of Solana's Blockchain Trends
research_method: examined abstract, time window and graduation-rate claim
claim: fewer than two percent of observed tokens transitioned to major decentralized exchanges
test_method: compared claim conceptually with local 2026 all-launch denominator and denominator definitions
result: supports severe class imbalance; exact rate not pooled because windows and graduation definitions differ
limitations: abstract-only audit and graduation is not a runner outcome

title: Predicting the success of new crypto-tokens: the Pump.fun case
research_method: examined paper metadata and success-prediction scope
claim: early measurable properties may predict token success
test_method: mapped candidate concept to strict fixed-frequency runner outcomes and anti-lookahead requirements
result: relevant hypothesis source; no claim imported into the model without independent replication
limitations: full method and artifact require deeper audit before any feature decision

title: PumpArchive API documentation
research_method: examined API documentation and probed the documented endpoints without credentials
claim: a free API provides programmatic Pump.fun historical data
test_method: called documented public endpoint variants and checked HTTP results
result: all tested documented endpoints returned HTTP 404; source rejected for current acquisition
limitations: service documentation and deployed API appear inconsistent

title: datastore.sh Pump.fun historical Parquet catalog
research_method: examined Pump.fun catalog, schema, versioning, checksum and lineage claims
data_window: recent through full available history depending on order
population: decoded Pump.fun launchpad and swap instruction/event tables
claim: versioned, checksummed historical Parquet can be delivered with configured coverage
test_method: mapped advertised tables and provenance contract to the 24-month evidence requirement
result: likely high-information acquisition path; no files acquired because purchase scope and authorization are absent
limitations: commercial quote required and completeness must be independently verified after delivery

title: Complete Pump.fun history: every create, trade and graduation
research_method: examined table schemas, coverage, scale, update cadence and provenance claims
data_window: Pump.fun genesis through prior UTC day as advertised
population: 14M+ creates, approximately 1.8B trades and post-graduation continuity as advertised
claim: monthly Parquet bundles contain complete decoded Pump.fun history with oracle and slot lineage
test_method: mapped advertised fields to creator, buyer, Jito, liquidity, lifecycle and post-migration requirements
result: best specified commercial candidate; not acquired because purchase authorization is absent
limitations: vendor claims and completeness remain unverified; commercial cost and terms apply
